{content.sampleTestCases.title}

{content.sampleTestCases.badge}
{content.sampleTestCases.cases.map(tc => (
{tc.id} {tc.priority}

{tc.title}

{tc.module}

{tc.description}

Preconditions

    {tc.preconditions.map((p, i) => (
  • {p}
    • ))}

Steps

    {tc.steps.map((s, i) => (
  1. {s}
    2. ))}

{Object.entries(tc.testData).map(([key, value]) => (
{key}: {value}
))}

))}
); }
